statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0 and R42
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The provided records do not sufficiently demonstrate medical necessity
Less intensive monitoring options were not attempted and failed prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
